claim_ceiling: Synthetic campaign plan only. No multi-utility deployment, defect detector, field POD or commercial service is qualified.

scenarios.name: One sewer-mounted fibre supports several sensing products
scenarios.conditions: One source stream is shared across independently qualified hydraulic, traffic and geophysical processing products.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Maintain separate truth, outputs, metrics, rights and claim boundaries per product.

scenarios.name: Controlled hydraulic intrusion produces localized transient response
scenarios.conditions: Contained laboratory/mock sewer with measured flow, fall height, water level and independent event time/location.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Evaluate time/frequency signature and manhole/segment localization under the tested flow envelope.

scenarios.name: Controlled exfiltration produces band-limited PSD signature
scenarios.conditions: Contained test pipe with known leak and independent hydraulic flow/pressure truth.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Evaluate paper-specific PSD feature in frozen profile; do not elevate 20–30 Hz to universal threshold.

scenarios.name: Structural defect exists but no water exchange or activation occurs
scenarios.conditions: CCTV/inspection truth confirms defect but hydraulic conditions produce no flow-induced vibration.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not assert DAS can identify all structural defects; record modality boundary and silent period.

scenarios.name: Urban field PSD screen finds candidate segments
scenarios.conditions: Operational 800 m sewer under traffic noise; field PSD candidate later examined by CCTV.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Keep candidate count separate from confirmed mechanism-specific truth; quantify denominators in future studies.

scenarios.name: DAS candidate segment is confirmed by independent CCTV
scenarios.conditions: CCTV reviewer and segment mapping are independent of DAS algorithm development.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Record confirmation rate and exact pipe segment, but do not generalize from two cases.

scenarios.name: DAS candidate has no corresponding visible defect on CCTV
scenarios.conditions: CCTV coverage/quality is adequate and independent adjudication finds no defect in the candidate segment.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Count as false candidate under the CCTV-visible defect taxonomy; preserve uncertainty for non-visible mechanisms.

scenarios.name: Traffic produces stronger vibration than hydraulically active defect
scenarios.conditions: Urban traffic overlaps the signal and elevates high-energy PSD bins.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Use persistence/spatiotemporal cues and independent traffic data; amplitude threshold alone fails.

scenarios.name: Sewer water level changes fluid–structure coupling
scenarios.conditions: Same defect/flow event measured at varying water depths and levels.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Stratify performance by water level and update observability state.

scenarios.name: Defect emits signal only during specific flow/groundwater periods
scenarios.conditions: Hydraulic truth logs show event-dependent activation and silent intervals.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Condition POD on activation state; report silent exposure as a separate intrinsic limitation.

scenarios.name: Model transfers from PVC to concrete/reinforced concrete
scenarios.conditions: Training and target pipe materials have different stiffness, damping and joint structure.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not pool results without held-out material qualification.

scenarios.name: Burial depth/backfill changes signal attenuation
scenarios.conditions: Same reference event under different burial/backfill and soil profiles.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Measure coupling transfer and spatial localization by profile.

scenarios.name: Controlled external impact excites buried concrete pipe
scenarios.conditions: Non-live approved testbed; impact energy/location, pipe response and independent defect truth are recorded.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Evaluate active-excitation structural screening precision/recall by defect severity.

scenarios.name: Active impact result is presented as passive monitoring performance
scenarios.conditions: Training/evaluation includes VFWD/external impact but product claim states continuous passive detection.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Separate active excitation benchmark and passive monitoring benchmark.

scenarios.name: Pipe bends/joints/supports create structural reflections
scenarios.conditions: Known geometry and defect-free bends/joints produce confounding response.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Measure false positive by bend, joint and support; include geometry-aware controls.

scenarios.name: No-defect pipe under ordinary flow/traffic
scenarios.conditions: Independent inspection shows no defect and sufficient background exposure exists.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Measure false alarms per observable pipe-km-day.

scenarios.name: Superlet-enhanced traffic trajectory segmentation
scenarios.conditions: Real-world traffic reference with synchronized video/GNSS and held-out sessions.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Compare IoU/Dice and trajectory quality on the same task; not a sewer defect metric.

scenarios.name: Traffic reference timebase is offset from DAS
scenarios.conditions: Offset/drift exceeds frozen synchronization tolerance.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject trajectory-to-DAS association until independently corrected.

scenarios.name: Road centreline and sewer alignment diverge
scenarios.conditions: Vehicle trajectory follows road but sewer is offset, curved or crosses laterally.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not map road track directly to pipe chainage; require survey transform.

scenarios.name: Multiple vehicles create overlapping trajectory signatures
scenarios.conditions: Independent video truth confirms overlapping vehicles and tracks.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Preserve multiple track hypotheses/abstain; report identity association error.

scenarios.name: Geophysical inversion recovers a known test anomaly
scenarios.conditions: Non-live geophysical testbed or independently surveyed known target with blind control points.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Measure depth/lateral resolution and coverage, not merely visual resemblance.

scenarios.name: Traffic/noise/coupling creates spurious subsurface inversion anomaly
scenarios.conditions: Independent geophysical control finds no target anomaly.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Count false geophysical anomaly and preserve inversion uncertainty.

scenarios.name: DAS anomaly and DTS thermal signature are fused
scenarios.conditions: Separate calibrated temperature and strain/acoustic channels have synchronized clocks and independent truth.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Test incremental defect-type discrimination; preserve modality-specific uncertainty.

scenarios.name: DAS anomaly corroborated with flow/level measurements
scenarios.conditions: Independent flow/level sensor is calibrated and its data is not derived from the DAS signal.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Measure decision improvement and discordant-sensor handling.

scenarios.name: Active impact method tested on real concrete drainage pipes
scenarios.conditions: Independent field study reports 12 pipes and 402 m with its own impact protocol and validation truth.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Treat 88.9% precision and 85.5% recall as paper-specific baseline only.

scenarios.name: Overlapping waveform windows from one physical event split across folds
scenarios.conditions: One physical event generates multiple crops or windows placed in train and test.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Group split by event/session/site; reject headline score if leakage occurs.

scenarios.name: Fibre/pipe/traffic data lacks owner permission or data rights
scenarios.conditions: Technical connectivity exists but permission/purpose authority is absent.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: No acquisition or processing; use synthetic/non-sensitive alternative.

scenarios.name: Active impact or hydraulic induction is proposed on operational pipe without approved method
scenarios.conditions: Plan could damage or disrupt live wastewater/civil infrastructure or expose staff to hazards.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Reject; use non-live/test rig or explicit engineering-approved safe plan.

scenarios.name: Second/third sensing product adds no material decision value
scenarios.conditions: Marginal product has high processing/retention/access cost but does not change investigation decisions.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Do not add the product solely because the fibre is already available.

scenarios.name: One cut or sewer-access closure removes all shared sensing products
scenarios.conditions: Multiple output services depend on the same fibre, interrogator, power and access point.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Model shared failure and residual observability; no false redundancy claim.

scenarios.name: Monitoring requires chamber access but permit is absent
scenarios.conditions: Chamber/fibre access is not authorized or safe.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: No entry or field work; retain remote-only or unobserved status.

scenarios.name: Multi-utility model evaluated on a new sewer/pipe site
scenarios.conditions: Complete route/site and event sessions are held out without target adaptation.
scenarios.oracle_requirement: Report per-product transfer and abstention; no pooled accuracy claim.

global_controls: Hydraulic, structural, traffic and geophysical observables have separate truth and metrics.
Active impact excitation and passive continuous observation are separate methods.
Structural defect presence does not imply hydraulically active DAS signature.
Paper-specific PSD bands and thresholds are not universal production thresholds.
Candidate field anomalies and independently CCTV-confirmed defects are separate counts.
Physical event IDs, not windows or crops, define independent event trials.
All evaluation splits are grouped by site, route, physical specimen, session and event.
Material, burial, water level, fluid–structure coupling and urban noise are explicit strata.
Road traffic location is not pipe chainage or sewer asset location.
Geophysical inversion anomalies are not asset identity.
Every product has separate observable/degraded/unobserved coverage and uncertainty.
Active tests occur only on safe approved non-live or specifically engineered testbeds.
No intentional fault, blockage, leak, exfiltration or damage is induced on live assets.
Owner rights, privacy and critical-geometry restrictions are hard constraints.
Shared fibre failure is treated as common cause across all dependent products.
Incremental product is not adopted unless its value exceeds added lifecycle cost.
